arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd FROM transactions AS t JOIN cards AS c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Sums the amount of every transaction on cards whose credit limit is above $20,000, expressed in dollars.
assumptions: Credit limit above $20,000 means credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000 (the column is in cents).
All transactions are included regardless of fraud label, since the question asks for the total amount, not a fraud rate.
Negative amounts (56,900 rows, meaning undocumented) are included as recorded, not excluded or treated as refunds.
Card type is not filtered, so Credit, Debit and Debit (Prepaid) cards are all included if their limit exceeds $20,000.
